propositions: Six subsystems (reconciler, plan_review/workflow, store/reducer, llm core, commands/CLI, root/services) contain ~2,033 lines of relocatable comment prose (history, architecture rationale, contracts) that should move to tickets, ADRs, schema, or code respectively.

The reconciler subsystem contains 28+ redundant comment blocks explaining an 800-line module cap, each occupying the budget it describes; these self-referential blocks should be collapsed to citations of a single ADR.

Three files (event_append.py, reducer/_processors.py, signing.py) contain load-bearing replay-compatibility and security invariants embedded in comments that cannot be relocated without losing correctness; these must be retained verbatim and recorded as do_not_move.

Six verified-stale comments document incorrect constraints (P1-P9 vs P1-P11 in DET_CHECKS, stale Anthropic rationale, non-existent module paths, missing map keys) that must be corrected in-place rather than deleted or relocated.
Nine new ADRs (0062-0069) must be created and committed before any inline comment block that will cite them is collapsed to a one-line reference.
All do_not_move lists from each shard must be appended to .joe-janitor/tools.md before that shard's edits land, creating a protection record against future over-aggressive comment sweeps.
